reason: E1 supports that larger atomic radii increase lattice distortion, but it does not link this to grain-boundary energy or stability. E2 attributes thermal stability to low grain-boundary energy in HEAs but does not connect this to atomic size mismatch. The causal chain from mismatch to distortion to grain-boundary energy to coarsening/segregation is not directly supported by the cited evidence.
premises: Larger atomic size mismatch increases lattice distortion in HEAs
Increased lattice distortion reduces grain-boundary energy
Reduced grain-boundary energy inhibits grain-boundary migration and diffusion
Inhibited migration/diffusion suppresses grain coarsening and chemical segregation
